scope: One explicit offline Half/Cross/Effect/Reference of already-completed typed wall33 review folders. Fresh JSON/CSV/PNG only. No solver, source/XML/input edits, native values overwritten, interpolation, smoothing or extra CNG native code.

upl_gpu_perm_pair_r1.py.use: Import only generic typed-export table/values/JSON/binding verification helpers; its512-specific loader/main are never called. Original half/effect budgets retained.

upl_cpu_public_compare_r1.py.use: Import original independent scaled4x4 reference(), normalizers and constant_errors(). Main is not run. Reference error fields use only actualXYZ,p,v,J, so calling the field function on strict33 arrays does not reinterpret old26 binaries.

CLI.Half: python upl_gpu_wall_pair_r1.py --action Half --a COARSE_REVIEW --b HALF_REVIEW --out NEW_PREFIX [--a-data RAW_A --b-data RAW_B]
CLI.Cross: Same action Cross, equal model/window/dt, one CPU and one GPU
CLI.Effect: Same action Effect, A=GPUconstant,B=GPUvariable,same full-window dt, plus --half-check PASSED_OWN_GPU_VARIABLE_HALF.json
CLI.Reference: --action Reference --a CONSTANT_FULL_REVIEW --out NEW_PREFIX [--a-data RAW_A]; no B or half-check
CLI.raw_proof: Optional explicit raw DATA directories avoid guessing future driver receipt schema. When supplied every current PART is rehashed against the bound reader before/after hashCSV, extra/missing PARTs rejected. Without it summary explicitly reports typed-export-only proof; neither mode claims owned solver exit or full endpoint audit. Root stage receipts must supply those independently.

geometry_schema.native_binary: Little-endian header[1024,33,257] full or[1024,33,17] k0-short, then actualtime+1024 rows per frame. Exact extent/noNaN/no trailing records. Old26 files rejected.
geometry_schema.CPU_only: cpu_posdiv.csv all samples1024 IDs, actual6J/derived arrays versus GPU3. GPU CPU-PosDiv fabrication rejected.
geometry_schema.fixed_conventions: Compare fixed IDs/real XYZ/planes exactly, not CPU zero-marker n against GPU reconstructed-sample n. Full fixed_samples checks staticXYZ/Jdomain/theta0 and backend-specific actual marker convention, never wall-material energy.
geometry_schema.material_band: Fixed at initial material min(x0,.0625-x0)<=2*float(1.8/512),exact256 soil IDs; not moved/reselected at later times.
geometry_schema.initial: All33 actual initial bit patterns must match for Half/Cross and also Effect. No signed-zero,theta,FSType,FSnormal or other initial diagnostic exception. MaterialXYZ initial tables are bit matched.

single_run_rechecks: Independent all-row J/n/V/rho/k ledger and5e-13 solid-volume identity
original energy<=1.1 including18K bulk denominator and full six-stress energy
positive-k continuous-domain margin,not applied to k0
all actual dyadic times,zero-based savedStep,finite signed dterror<=1e-14
all source/export input hashes rechecked before finishing

Half.identity: Same backend/model/window,coarse2^-25 then half2^-26; all17 k0-short or257 full exact-time/ID samples
Half.absolute: PressureRMS<=5Pa and max fullXYZ material-displacement difference<=.005mm

Cross.hard: Original pressureRMS<=5Pa and max fullXYZ material-u difference<=.005mm
Cross.normalized: Descriptive only,never imposed as a half bound
Cross.passive_density: Report passiveRhop differences; no CPUrational/GPUadditive equality gate

Effect.identity: Full GPUconstantA versusGPUvariableB,same dt and initial all33 bits exact
Effect.own_half: Require a passed own variableGPU Half from this frozen recipe,coarse/half side folder+completion exactly identifies B; verify original full metricCSV and all bound inputs/files
Effect.hard: max option pressureRMS strictly>max(.001Pa,10*max own GPUhalf pressureRMS)
Effect.not: Option response is not half,backend,theory error or automatic accuracy improvement; manufacturedCk2^-13 is not calibration

Reference.allowed: Positive constant model/full257 only. Variable-k and k0-short receive no fabricated constant-k continuum gate.
Reference.expm: Original cpu_public_compare reference() scaled augmented[u,v,sigma,p]4x4 matrix exponential with actual float-promotedK/G/Kw/rho/n0/k0,gravity0 and completed-acceleration Darcy term.
Reference.RK4_crosscheck: Independent physical derivative du=v,dv=kappa(p-sigma)/rho,dsigma=M*kappa*v,dp=-B*kappa*v-D*kappa^2*p+D*rhow*kappa*dv. Increment each actual cadence by16 and32 RK4 pieces. Original absolute pressure self-check<=1e-8Pa; normalizedexpm/RK gap<2e-11.
Reference.scientific_error: All257 fullXYZ p/v/u normalizedRMS globally and in exact256-particle materialband,plus final pressure-cosine-mode relative error. Exact retained constant_errors() is called and verified, no scalar-only substitution.
Reference.hard: Original max(global p/v/uRMS)<=.01,max(material-band p/v/uRMS)<=.01,abs(endpointpressuremode relativeerror)<=.01. A failed objective writes passedfalse with scientificCSV/PNG,not a relaxed target.
Reference.not: No variable-k analytical truth, no generalwall or fullphysical acceptance, no dependence on storedRK/reference columns as truth.

plotting: Simple2x2 scientific pressure/velocity/materialu mode versus actualtime and comparison/error histories. Every declared time retained inCSV/curves, no smoothing, clipping, rescaling or missing-field substitution. Modal plots do not replace fullXYZ error tests.
outputs: NEW_PREFIX.json/.csv/.png; all must be absent before analysis. Report input bindings, scientific maxes, backend/fixed marker distinctions, optional current raw hash status and precise scope.
not_proven_here: Owned solver exit/program/source/runtime provenance,which root receipts must bind
All257 endpoint face/force/rate audits,which remain a separate required gate
Original integration-stage theta/C/Ace or between-save flux
